run_setup_wizard: run the interactive LiteLLM setup wizard to configure LLM providers and generate a proxy config file
create_SETUP_WIZARD_run: create a LiteLLM proxy config by running the SetupWizard.run() interactive onboarding wizard
build_SETUP_WIZARD_config: build a litellm_config.yaml file with selected providers, API keys, and proxy settings using SetupWizard._build_config
test_SETUP_WIZARD_validation: test provider API key validation using SetupWizard._validate_and_report with check_valid_key
summarize_SETUP_WIZARD_providers: summarize the available LLM providers from the PROVIDERS list including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, and Ollama
